messages:
ida: Opening a tiny quickstart refresh PR to shorten the Hello World, standardize on RW_API_KEY, and add a minimal Docker run. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/820. Can docs/devex take a quick look?
sam: I'll review. Please include a curl-first smoke test so people can try without installing SDKs. Example:
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $RW_API_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"open-redwood/1.0","input":"hi"}'
michael: adding a short migration note mapping RED_TOKEN -> RW_API_KEY and OLD_HOST -> RW_API_HOST so enterprise scripts don't break. Also suggest a one-line PowerShell env example for Windows.
ida: good call. I'll add export/setx examples and mention Console -> Settings -> API Tokens for grabbing keys.
sam: small nit: mention api.redwood.eu for EU customers as a footnote.
michael: can we add an optional GH Action that lints snippets (node --check, python -m py_compile, go vet) gated by SNIPPET_CI so it doesn't run for forks? That would catch syntax regressions.
ida: yes, will add an opt-in workflow and keep network calls disabled.
deploy-bot: Preview for PR #820 available: https://deploy.preview.redwood.ai/pr-820 (expires in 7 days).
ida: thanks all ":thumbsup:" I'll merge after one +1 and CI green.
